groups.title: Part 1 · Your neighbourhood
groups.instructions: Answer the questions naturally. This is recorded practice, not a live examiner interview.

questions.prompt: What do you like about the area where you live?
Has your neighbourhood changed since you first moved there?
What would you improve about your neighbourhood?

groups.title: Part 2 · A useful skill
groups.instructions: Take one minute to prepare, then speak for one to two minutes.
groups.passage: Describe a useful skill that you learned. You should say: what the skill is; when and how you learned it; why you learned it; and explain how this skill helps you in your daily life.

groups.title: Part 3 · Learning and society
groups.instructions: Discuss the following questions in greater depth.

questions.prompt: How has technology changed the way people learn new skills?
Should schools place more emphasis on practical skills?
